import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species whitespace variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    # Fix island case variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    # Fix body_mass_g written as text with commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    # Ensure numeric columns are numeric (defensive)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
